bio.text: Michael Bouchard is the Republican candidate for Michigan's 10th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to his campaign website, he graduated from Michigan State University's ROTC program and served in the 82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions, including missions to the Southern Border and Iraq.

The campaign website also says he was chief operations officer of an infantry battalion in the Michigan Army National Guard and most recently a member of a joint task force in the fight against ISIS, earning the Bronze Star.
According to the campaign website, his father is Oakland County Sheriff Mike Bouchard; the candidate is a different person.
